questions.question: A rival beats your score by one point. What do you do?

options.text: Study three more hours and act like it did not bother me
Cheer for them out loud, then challenge them to a game
Quietly find out which topics they know that I do not
Plan a clever comeback and keep a perfectly straight face

questions.question: The free period starts and the room is yours. You reach for:

options.text: A board game, and everyone is playing whether they like it or not
A handheld console and a pair of headphones
The to-do list, then tea for the whole room
A good seat, where I can look busy while I wait for someone else to speak first

questions.question: A friend asks you for love advice. You:

options.text: Tell them plainly to go and say it already
Listen first, then ask what they actually want
Start with my own good news and forget to ask about theirs
Give a confident theory that is half guesswork

questions.question: Your phone dies at the worst moment. Your first thought:

options.text: Fine, I have a pen, paper and an old-fashioned way to do this
Borrow someone else's before I miss anything
A quiet hour at last, I will notice more without it
Text everyone from a different device and make a joke of it

questions.question: Photo day. Which look is yours?

options.text: Neat and correct, not a thread out of place
Trendy, with sharp details, nails and accessories
Whatever I woke up in, hair flying, grin on
Hoodie, headphones round my neck, look away

questions.question: Someone you secretly like walks in. You:

options.text: Act as if I do not care, and wait for them to make the first move
Walk over calmly while my heart pounds under a steady face
Wave, shout their name and ask what is for lunch
Watch from across the room and see everything
A volunteering club, with a rota and a clean-up every month
Astronomy: a cold night, a telescope, and all the time I want
A band, a sports team or any stage with a crowd
A support club that helps others, from behind the curtain

questions.question: A friend is hiding a secret you guessed long ago. You:

options.text: Say nothing and let them tell it in their own time
Tease them until they crack
Quietly arrange things so it works out for them
Ask straight out, then forget to follow up
